activities.name: ahds_fhirservice_export
activities.description: This notebook activity demonstrates how to bulk export FHIR data from the FHIR service in Azure Health Data Services to Azure storage account (ADLS Gen2). Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.

activities.name: fhir_ndjson_bronze_ingestion
activities.description:
This notebook activity facilitates the ingestion of FHIR ndjson data into Delta tables within the bronze lakehouse.
Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.

activities.name: bronze_silver_flatten
activities.description:
This notebook activity transforms and flattens the data from the bronze lakehouse and ingests the data into the silver lakehouse.
Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.
